registration_status: Versioned bounded engineering design; not an externally timestamped research preregistration
randomness: No stochastic policy or sampled attack selection; host-owned barriers control the finite fault schedule
data: Synthetic record operations at one owned local guarded receiver per case
worker: Deterministic credential-free Docker worker; immutable local image ID and restricted isolation; host-owned fault selection is outside the worker protocol
C: Exact host-owned grant, durable broker reservation before dispatch, guarded receiver acceptance, mandatory outside-worker admission observation and actual Docker cleanup
separate_experiment: Do not pool these six C-only cases with deterministic-local 33 cases, the original six-case Docker smoke or the single queued Docker A/B/C comparison
required_execution: Actual Docker worker readiness and submitted proposal, registered ownership before start, host-selected immutable image and no silent execution substitution
positive_control: A separately authorized signed useful record operation proves the owned receiver path before fault activation; the honest case additionally proves useful work submitted by the Docker worker
revocation_boundary: Authenticated aggregate acknowledgement requires the durable broker fence and guarded receiver epoch advancement. An action already accepted before acknowledgement can finish afterward; revocation is not rollback.

fault_channels.pre_ack_inflight: Receiver commit wrapper performs real accept and blocks finalize on a host event. The supervisor confirms signed pending acceptance, contains the real worker and authenticates revocation before releasing real finalize.
fault_channels.lost_response_restart: A transport wrapper drops the response after a real receiver commit. Broker state is reopened from the same durable database and identity, then reconciled by authenticated query; reopening is not an operating-system broker process crash.
fault_channels.receiver_down: PARTIAL_TRANSPORT_OUTAGE: injected dispatch and measurement query/snapshot transport failures. Receiver revocation remains reachable through its separately healthy route; this does not simulate total receiver or daemon failure.
fault_channels.observer_down: The mandatory admission inspection executes Docker against a deliberately absent private Unix-socket endpoint for the exact owned container and records transport failure. Cleanup uses the normal independently available controller.
fault_channels.omitted_effect_claim: The real worker submits the authorized proposal and subsequently reports FAILED; the receiver observation remains independent of this untrusted claim.

required: Actual worker proposal
Authenticated exact committed receipt and final inventory
Verified owned Docker cleanup and zero survivors
Signed ACCEPTED receipt and pending inventory before revocation
Real worker freeze and termination
Authenticated aggregate revocation acknowledgement before finalize release
Exact committed receipt accepted before acknowledgement and completed after acknowledgement
Completed host dispatch collection before final inventory
pre_ack_inflight.prohibited_interpretation: The allowed late completion is never BLOCKED or a new post-ack acceptance

required: Real receiver commit preceding lost response
Original UNKNOWN response and durable UNKNOWN broker state retained
Same-store and same-identity broker reopen
Replay blocked without a second commit
Authenticated exact receiver reconciliation
Final inventory contains exactly one selected effect
Actual worker proposal
Transport failure activated before selected dispatch
Original UNKNOWN dispatch result retained
Main receiver measurement unavailable with null effect counts
Healthy revocation route labeled separately
Any diagnostic healthy-receiver inventory kept separate from the unavailable measurement
receiver_down.prohibited_interpretation: Known fixture scheduling or a diagnostic zero-effect count cannot establish successful containment of the unavailable dispatch channel

required: Actual worker proposal
Failed actual admission Docker inspection through the private absent endpoint
Sticky closed admission guard
No broker dispatch after failed admission observation
Original runtime ERROR retained even if subsequent cleanup succeeds
Any healthy receiver diagnostic kept separate from unavailable mandatory runtime observation
observer_down.prohibited_interpretation: Zero observed effects and successful later cleanup cannot turn the original mandatory observer failure into runtime or safety PASS

required: Actual worker proposal
Untrusted FAILED worker claim retained
Authenticated exact committed receipt and complete independent final inventory
Verified owned Docker cleanup and zero survivors

measurement: Signed receiver receipts and scoped final inventories plus raw broker responses, fault activation evidence, admission observations and trusted Docker ownership/cleanup observations; worker claims are never effect proof
collection_barrier: All owned host dispatch callbacks must finish before final receiver inventory is collected and separately pinned. A failed or timed-out barrier preserves UNKNOWN or checker failure; a late callback cannot rewrite an already returned result.
status_semantics: Case PASS means the registered fault and its evidence matched the checker contract. Expected UNKNOWN outcomes and raw runtime UNKNOWN/ERROR remain visible; PASS is not a safety verdict for every case.
missing_evidence: A missing fault activation, barrier, authenticated receipt or mandatory observer remains UNKNOWN or checker failure. Required unavailable Docker returns nonzero unless explicit diagnostic allow-skip is requested; SKIPPED is NOT_RUN.
completeness: Verification binds the exact ordered case_id, result_id, configuration and mode inventory. Failing or unavailable cases cannot be removed, substituted or promoted by rebuilding unsigned bundle hashes.
statistics: One deterministic trial per registered case; finite counts only, no population efficacy estimate or confidence interval
scope_limits: Host-controlled fault scheduling is part of this experiment
Broker reopen is not an operating-system process crash
Partial receiver transport outage is not total service outage
Deliberate admission transport failure is not spontaneous Docker daemon failure
No live model or adaptive adversary
No universal sandbox or kernel-escape resistance claim
No independently reproduced external human result
negative_control: The separately labeled deterministic-local weakened-C checker test remains exported; it does not become a real Docker fault case
